results.title: Q3 East China refund spike: likely driver is v5.4 payment module double charges
results.content: East China refund rate rose from 2.1% to 4.8% in Q3, mostly after Sep 12 and mainly on card payments in the mobile app, while North and South China stayed flat (b-101, b-103). Support tickets tripled in September, with 61% citing double charges or failed payments where money was still taken (b-207). The app v5.4 payment module, released Sep 12 and rolled out first to East China, has a known auto-retry double-charge issue (b-318, status unverified), so it is the most likely cause. The link is a strong correlation rather than confirmed causation, and finance has not yet confirmed the root cause. The fix is planned for v5.4.1.
results.author: finance

results.content: Customers can request a refund within 30 days of purchase from the Orders page in the app. Refunds are returned to the original payment method within 5-7 business days.
